**No—the 2025 loss is not yet confirmed as persistent.** Hansen data maps a tree-cover loss candidate of approximately 13.5 hectares, or 3.91% of the property.

The JRC map shows forest in 2020 across 98% of the candidate area, but that establishes the earlier forest cover, not whether the loss persisted. Because 2025 is the latest year observed, a later year is needed for corroboration. The assessment remains **pending corroboration**.

The evidence also does not establish the cause of the loss or whether it was deforestation.
